title: Pinned chrome "per-question Save (desktop)" not rendered — desktop per-question button always reads "Continue"; save_label is dead
evidence:
form_question_pages.gleam:174-176:
        html.button(
          [
            attribute.type_("submit"),
            attribute.class("btn-submit"),
            attribute("data-testid", "reference-continue"),
          ],
          [html.text(form_copy.continue_label)],

form_copy.gleam:94:
  pub const save_label = "Save"

(grep: save_label referenced nowhere except its definition and the copy-test string enumeration; reference_form.js performs no label swap — desktop layout is 'all the forms in one scroll')
detail: Pinned chrome: "per-screen primary Continue (mobile) / per-question Save (desktop)". view_actions renders continue_label for every question on every viewport; save_label is never rendered, so the desktop per-question button deviates from the pinned copy.
recommended_fix: Render form_copy.save_label as the per-question submit text on the desktop single-page layout (and continue_label on mobile), or drop the Save/desktop claim from the spec's pinned chrome.
